data.one_liner: Reactive state management, dependency injection, and event handling for Flutter and Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides lightweight reactive state management, built-in dependency injection, and an event handler for Flutter applications. Offers granular reactivity using states and hooks with zero code generation.
use_when: You want reactive state management without code generation.
You need built-in dependency injection alongside state management.
You prefer using custom hooks for reusable state logic.
avoid_when: You are already heavily invested in another state management library like Riverpod or Bloc.
You require strictly stream-based architectures exclusively.
strengths: Zero code generation and zero configuration
Granular reactivity and total rendering control
Includes dependency injection and event handling out of the box
Fully debuggable via Reactter DevTools extension
weaknesses: Smaller community and ecosystem compared to older giants like Provider or Bloc
Documentation is mostly hosted externally on the official website
data.setup_notes: No native setup steps or code generators are required.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick provider if you want a classic, widely adopted dependency injection and state propagation tool backed by the Flutter team.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick riverpod for compile-safe, decoupled state management without relying on BuildContext.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick bloc if you need strict separation of business logic via events and states with predictable state transitions.
